dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: *sigh* It got away, again... Ah! Stranger danger!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you wanna play with me?

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: Ooh, can I, can I!? Now I don't have to play with my shadow! ...Okay, let's play hide-and-seek! Hide-and-seeeek!

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: Little Liu, Little Xing, and Dongdong always want to play that but everyone wants to hide and no one wants to seek.

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: Okay, first we'll go hide and then the game will start. No peeking! ...Wait, I still need to tell the others...

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: #QUICK! HIDE! {M#HE}{F#SHE}'S COMING!!!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can help you.

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: Thanks for the offer, but I can do it.

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: I'm the one my whole family worries about, and I've had enough of it.

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: If I prove I'm as smart as my big brother then Granddad will stop worrying about me, and so will Mommy and Daddy, who work far away from home.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't you play with your big brother?

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: I really want to, but... It seems like he doesn't want to, he's really busy and— and I think he might be trying to avoid me.

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: Granddad says I should be a good girl. I don't want to annoy my big brother.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I won't hurt you. What are you chasing?

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: My shadow. Everyone says I won't be able to catch it, including my big brother.

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: *sigh* It got away, again... Ah! Stranger danger!

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: My big brother is the smartest person I know. He can do anything I ask him to! But even he couldn't catch my shadow...

dialogues.speaker: Little You
dialogues.text: I'm sure there must be a way, though, and once I've caught it, it'll prove that I'm as smart as him!
